description: Generic SNES game profile. Maps the universal action vocabulary to the SNES diamond layout (A east, B south, Y west, X north). Western convention: A is confirm, B is cancel. Suitable as a vision-only default for any SNES title without a game-specific profile.

confirm.hint: Press A. Advance dialog, confirm menu choice, primary action. Western convention; Japanese-only SNES games may invert this.

cancel.hint: Press B. Cancel menu, run (in some RPGs), secondary action.

special.hint: Press Y. Game-specific: secondary attack, sub-weapon, sprint in platformers.

use_item.hint: Press X. Game-specific: tertiary action, item, often the inventory hotkey.

menu.hint: Press Start. Open the pause menu, start the game on the title screen.

back.hint: Press Select. Game-specific: secondary menu, swap character, mode switch.

nav_up.hint: Walk / move up. In menus: cursor up.

nav_down.hint: Walk / move down. In menus: cursor down.

nav_left.hint: Walk / move left. In menus: cursor left.

nav_right.hint: Walk / move right. In menus: cursor right.

notes: L and R are exposed as hardware passthrough — many SNES games use them for non-universal verbs (weapon cycling, page scrolling, dash). Per-game profiles should bind them to a specific universal action when possible.
